query.description: The customer's question, restated as one clear standalone question in standard Serbian to search the knowledge base. Keep the topic and intent; leave out specific product names, brands and quantities. For a short follow-up, carry the topic from earlier turns and ask what is new in this message.

wrapup.description: The knowledge-base wrap-up code this question belongs to. Pick the single best-matching value; this guarantees that whole topic is loaded for you. Use empty string only if genuinely none fits.
